    AND (ROUND(CAST(mt.latitude AS DECIMAL), 1), ROUND(CAST(mt.longitude AS DECIMAL), 1)) IN ((39.5, 8.6))
  GROUP BY
    mt.latitude,
    mt.longitude
), max_temp_value AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(annual_temps.avg_annual_tmean_k) AS highest_avg_k
  FROM annual_temps
), hottest_grids AS (
  SELECT
    annual_temps.latitude AS latitude,
    annual_temps.longitude AS longitude,
    annual_temps.avg_annual_tmean_c AS avg_annual_tmean_c
  FROM annual_temps
  WHERE
    annual_temps.avg_annual_tmean_k = (
      SELECT
        max_temp_value.highest_avg_k AS highest_avg_k
      FROM max_temp_value
    )
), level1_counts AS (
  SELECT
    h.latitude AS latitude,
    h.longitude AS longitude,
    lt.level1_code AS level1_code,

    level1_counts.longitude AS longitude,
    level1_counts.level1_code AS level1_code,
    level1_counts.level1_label AS level1_label,

      PARTITION BY level1_counts.latitude, level1_counts.longitude
